📦 **meadow-food-frames-core `9ea8e4b`** — Show food quality with transparent four-grade dish frames

Render 32px frames below 24px dish sprites, with visible grade text in previous-day meals. Resolve grades from home/direct/service/ship metadata; unknown grades retain ordinary icons. Missing frames retain dishes; missing dishes retain labels. Apply frames to home, ship and service building menus too.

Build --code and AST/global/layer gates pass; srccheck 4cf21c45a9f833e2 (187 sources, 41 unchanged ship files). Actual globe -> built town UI screenshots show all four grades using a controlled meal record restored without saving. Source checks cover 29 home, 24 direct, 14 service and 7 ship entries with unchanged portion/percentage cells; service panel regression passes.

Refs TASK-1167

👥 參與者：@meadow

---
